question: Which of the following is considered the first full-length Indian feature film, released in 1913?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Raja Harishchandra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Raja Harishchandra** is considered the **first full-length Indian feature film**, released in **1913**.
 
• It was directed and produced by **Dadasaheb Phalke**, who is regarded as the **Father of Indian Cinema**.
 
• The film is based on the legendary story of Kin
